title: Which SpongeBob character are you? Free quiz — cv.cm
description: Free SpongeBob quiz: answer 12 questions to find out if you're SpongeBob, Patrick, Squidward, Sandy, Mr. Krabs, Plankton, Pearl or Gary. Unofficial fan quiz, no sign-up.
lede: Cheerful like SpongeBob, relaxed like Patrick or grumpy like Squidward? Answer 12 questions about your job, your weekends and your neighbors to find your Bikini Bottom match.
about: SpongeBob SquarePants has made viewers laugh since 1999 with the life of an overexcited sea sponge and his neighbors in Bikini Bottom. Each character is a type we all know: SpongeBob's endless enthusiasm, Patrick's happy laziness, Squidward's artistic grumpiness, Sandy's brains and karate, Mr. Krabs's love of money, Plankton's big schemes, Pearl's teenage drama and Gary's quiet wisdom. This quiz matches you with one of these eight.

Your result names your character and shows your scores for all eight. This is an unofficial fan quiz written for cv.cm. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Nickelodeon, Paramount or the creators of SpongeBob SquarePants; the names belong to their owners.

spongebob.name: SpongeBob SquarePants
spongebob.body: You are cheerful, hard-working and full of energy. You see the best in everyone, put your whole heart into your job and turn ordinary days into adventures. Some people find you a lot before breakfast, but nobody can stay grumpy around you for long.

patrick.name: Patrick Star
patrick.body: You are relaxed, loyal and wonderfully uncomplicated. You enjoy simple pleasures, a good nap and a day out with your best friend. You may not think too hard about things, but every now and then you say something surprisingly wise.

squidward.name: Squidward Tentacles
squidward.body: You are creative, sharp and a little bit fed up with everyone. You long for peace, quiet and a world that appreciates your art. Under the eye-rolls you have a dry sense of humor, and secretly you'd be lost without the noisy people around you.

sandy.name: Sandy Cheeks
sandy.body: You are clever, brave and always up for a challenge, whether that's an experiment, a workout or a karate match. You love learning and you don't back down. You're also a loyal friend who'll help anyone with a problem, as long as it's interesting.

krabs.name: Mr. Krabs
krabs.body: You are hard-working, practical and very good with money. You know the value of every coin and you built something to be proud of. You're tough but fair, and when it really counts you care about your crew and your family more than your wallet, usually.

plankton.name: Plankton
plankton.body: You are ambitious, inventive and you never, ever give up. You always have a plan, and a backup plan for when that fails. You may be small but your dreams are huge. Try teaming up with people instead of beating them; you might be surprised how far you go.

pearl.name: Pearl Krabs
pearl.body: You care about style, music and what's cool, and you feel everything in a big way. You love your friends, your shopping trips and your family, even when they embarrass you. Your passion is your power; just remember not every bad moment is the end of the world.

gary.name: Gary the Snail
gary.body: You are calm, quiet and wiser than people think. You don't need to say much; you notice everything and you're there when it matters. You know how to enjoy a simple life: good food, a warm spot and the company of someone you love.
